research:
Season context: opener for both. 2025-26: PHX 45-37 (ORtg 115.4, DRtg 113.9, pace 97.2); POR 42-40 (114.4/114.7/100.5), lost to SA in the playoffs (Basketball-Reference, AP).
POR changes (CBS, SI, Blazers Edge): Damian Lillard returns after missing all of 2025-26 (Achilles), and Ja Morant arrived by trade (79 games in 3 seasons); Holiday, Avdija, Clingan and Camara return. Sharpe is out (meniscus).
PHX: Booker, Jalen Green, Brooks and Bridges, with Mark Williams out (shoulder), so Maluach or Ighodaro starts at C; Kennard (new, knee) is day-to-day. Jordan Ott's Suns went 1-4 in preseason, and Buckley ranks their starting five 20th.
Usage 2025-26 (Basketball-Reference): Morant 32.5% (MEM, 20 g), Booker 32.2%, J. Green 31.9% (32 g), Sharpe 30.5% (out), Avdija 29.3%, Brooks 28.6%, Henderson 25.0%, Holiday 23.5%. Lillard has no 2025-26 sample. POR's new guard trio will split the touches, which lowers each one's usage.
DvP (Fantasy Team Advice/Hashtag, rank 30 = most allowed; two snapshots): POR vs PG 15/18, SG 14/22, SF 22/26; PHX vs PG 8/7, SG 4/8, SF 11/6. Rotogrinders' Phoenix and Portland rows could not be retrieved.
Hit rates (2025-26 logs): Brooks 9+ pts 53/56 (40/42 with Booker playing), 2+ reb only 50/56, assists below 93% at 1+; Booker 16+ pts 60/64, 1+ reb 61/64, 3+ ast 60/64. Booker averaged 26.1/3.9/6.0 and Brooks 20.2/3.6/1.8.
SGP: hit-rate product 0.832, shrunk a third toward the normal-approx fair to 0.784. Implied 0.763 from estimated alts (Brooks -1106, Booker pts -1096, ast -984). The edge is thin and rests on estimates; it is not highlighted because Booker's DvP gate is unconfirmed.
Totals (method): pace avg 98.85. PHX = avg(115.4, 114.7) x 0.9885 = 113.7; POR = avg(114.4, 113.9) x 0.9885 = 112.8; total 226.6 vs DK 231.5 (opened 236.5), 4.9 under, so the Under is a leg. The model margin is PHX +0.9 before about 2 points of home court.
Injuries (ESPN, CBS, Blazers Edge, Rip City Project): POR Avdija questionable (right ankle soreness, expected to play; if out, Cissoko starts and Morant's usage rises), Potter questionable (illness), Sharpe, Carlson (concussion) and Youngblood out. PHX: M. Williams out, Kennard day-to-day.
Lines (ESPN DK): POR -2.5 (-115)/PHX +2.5 (-105), opened -4.5; total 231.5 (o -112/u -108), opened 236.5; ML POR -142/PHX +120 (opened -170/+142). Elsewhere: Dimers POR -4.5, 235.5; Picks and Parlays -4.5, 235.5, POR -175; Gainblers DK -172/+142 (older numbers).
Predictors: ESPN BPI POR 58.3%; Dimers POR 66%, 119-115; iHeart POR 114-112 and Under 232.5 (projects 226.9); Docsports PHX +3.5; Pickdawgz notes the last five PHX-POR games at Moda went Over. Lean POR, with both line and total moving PHX's way and toward the Under.
History: PHX won 2 of 3 in 2025-26 and beat POR in the April 2026 play-in; POR went 3-1 in preseason including a 119-66 win over London.
Props seen: Booker 24.5 pts, 3.5 reb, 5.5 ast; Morant 18.5/3.5/4.5; Brooks 17.5/3.5/1.5 (Bleacher Nation); Brooks 18.5 o +100/+114, u -113/-130 (Optimal Bet); Booker steals o0.5 +113 Kalshi (Dimers).
Coaching: POR plays fast (100.5 pace) and its guard-heavy lineups may push Holiday to forward if Avdija sits (Rip City Project); PHX plays slow (97.2) and its center depth is thin without Williams.
Most likely leg: Booker o15.5 points (60/64 last season, locked-in role).
